# Hamlet Editor 1.0.0

The first public release of Hamlet Editor, an unofficial desktop save editor for Darkest Dungeon 1 on Windows, macOS and Linux.

- Edit heroes, estate resources, town buildings and the active raid.
- Revive fallen heroes in town when the roster has room. Lost skill upgrades are not restored.
- Manage trinket inventory and equipment, including DLC items and class restrictions.
- Save with validation, game-running checks and protection against external save changes. Create backups and restore earlier saves with a safety backup first.
- Detect Steam saves and game installations. Quit Darkest Dungeon before editing. Restores that add or remove Steam save files also require Steam to be quit completely.

These installers are unsigned or ad-hoc signed. See the README for platform installation instructions and first-launch warnings. Keep a separate backup of your campaign before editing.
